blocks.text: 🪝 ADB Approves  Million Loan for PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSGMBY). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Accelerates Subprogram 2 for rooftop solar installations across 10 million low & middle-income households.
Multilateral Funding: ADB  loan adds to  package previously approved by World Bank.
Subsidy Structure: PMSGMBY (₹75,021 cr outlay) provides ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW solar systems.
